Container.Name: Savorly
Container.Overview: A calm, self-hosted weekly meal planner with calorie and protein goals, recipe discovery, one-pot meal prep, and automatic shopping lists.
Container.Requires: Internet access is required for USDA, TheMealDB, and remote recipe images.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port used to open Savorly in your browser.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent meal plans, recipes, ratings, and settings.

Config.Name: USDA API Key
Config.Description: Optional FoodData Central key. Leave blank to use the limited USDA demo key.

Config.Name: TheMealDB API Key
Config.Description: The free personal/development key is 1. Replace it with a supporter key if applicable.

Config.Name: SMTP Host
Config.Description: Mail server hostname, for example smtp.example.com.

Config.Name: SMTP Port
Config.Description: Use 465 for implicit TLS or commonly 587 for STARTTLS.

Config.Name: SMTP Secure
Config.Description: Set true for implicit TLS, normally on port 465. Use false for port 587.

Config.Name: Require STARTTLS
Config.Description: Set true to require a STARTTLS upgrade on connections such as port 587.

Config.Name: SMTP Username
Config.Description: SMTP account username, often your email address. Leave both username and password blank for an internal relay.

Config.Name: SMTP Password
Config.Description: SMTP password or provider-issued app password.

Config.Name: Email From
Config.Description: Sender address accepted by your SMTP provider.

Config.Name: Shopping List Recipient
Config.Description: Fixed address that receives shopping lists.
